label: prop:chain-ring-comparison
title: Predicted vs. observed $\mathrm{C}_6$ ring-closure barrier
html:
Proposition. Predicted vs. observed \mathrm{C}_6 ring-closure barrier

Theoretical prediction. The energy difference between the chain and threaded ring is proportional to the difference in Alexander weights:

  \Delta E
   \propto 
  \bigl[(N-1) - \Delta_{T(2,N)}(q)\bigr]
  \cdot |q + q^{-1}|_{\mathrm{mol}}.

For N = 6 with |q + q^{-1}|_{\mathrm{mol}} \sim 1\text{--}2 eV and weight difference 5 - 3 = 2:

  \Delta E(6)
   \sim 
  2 \times (1\text{--}2 \mathrm{eV})
   \sim 
  2\text{--}4 \mathrm{eV}
   \approx 
  193\text{--}386 \mathrm{kJ/mol}.
